# Carapace spear

Internal ID: SpearCarapace | Type: Spear | Source: Black forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Yggdrasil wood x15, Carapace x12, Mandible x3 | Attack speed: 1.04 s (includes picking up) | Hitbox: 1.9 range, 40 angle, 1.5 height, 0.5 ray | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Carapace spear is the fifth spear. Its primary attack is a thrust. Its secondary attack throws the spear for 1.5x damage.
